Do what Plivo does when a call reaches your answer URL, from this machine
and without placing a call: request --answer-url with --answer-method and
the fields Plivo sends (CallUUID, From, To, Direction, CallStatus), signed
with X-Plivo-Signature-V3 when a profile is logged in; check the reply (a
2xx within Plivo's 15 seconds, its content type, and Plivo XML with a
<Stream>); then open the <Stream>'s WebSocket and stream --duration seconds
of a 1 kHz tone in its contentType, as `voice streams test` does, reading back
what the voice agent sends when the stream is bidirectional.

--xml-only stops after the XML and opens no WebSocket. Only the answer
document is read: no <Redirect> or action URL is followed. A Plivo-hosted
answer URL (a console flow or an agent) is refused with nothing sent: a
request there would run it for real.

A pass means your server answers this machine as Plivo needs, not that
Plivo can reach it or that a caller hears the audio. Exit 0 on a pass; 1
when a check fails, 2 when the WebSocket refuses the upgrade, 3 when a host
cannot be reached or the WebSocket closes before the stop frame. -o json
prints checks[] and the stream summary; when a check fails it prints only
the error, with checks[] in error.context.

Usage:
  plivo voice streams simulate [flags]

Examples:
  plivo voice streams simulate --answer-url https://agent.example.com/answer
  plivo voice streams simulate --answer-url https://agent.example.com/answer --answer-method GET --to +14155551234 -o json
  plivo voice streams simulate --answer-url https://agent.example.com/answer --xml-only

Flags:
      --answer-method string   GET|POST, as set on the application (default "POST")
      --answer-url string      the answer URL to request, as Plivo would (required)
      --direction string       inbound|outbound, sent as Direction (default "inbound")
      --duration int           seconds of synthetic audio to stream (max 30) (default 3)
      --expect-audio           fail unless playAudio comes back; the audio is a tone, so only an echo-style agent or one that speaks first answers
      --from string            the caller, sent as From (default "+14155551234")
  -h, --help                   help for simulate
      --insecure               skip TLS verification (self-signed dev certs only)
      --to string              the number called, sent as To (default "+14155555678")
      --xml-only               stop after the answer URL and its XML: open no WebSocket

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            preview requests and local changes without sending or writing anything
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json|jsonl|yaml|csv (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
      --query string       JMESPath filter on the JSON output, e.g. 'data.objects[].call_uuid' (implies -o json)
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --schema             describe the command (arguments, flags, output fields) instead of running it
      --show-secrets       show auth tokens and passwords in API responses instead of [REDACTED]
      --timeout duration   request timeout: seconds, or a duration such as 90s or 2m (default 30s)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts
